products.name: Classic Oxford Button-Down Shirt
products.description: A timeless wardrobe essential crafted from 100% premium long-staple cotton with a tailored modern fit, durable mother-of-pearl buttons, and a structured button-down collar designed for all-day comfort.

products.name: Supima Crewneck T-Shirt
products.description: Engineered from ultra-soft California Supima cotton, this premium crewneck t-shirt offers an exceptionally smooth hand feel, reinforced shoulder seams, and shape-retaining collar ribbing.

products.name: Raw Selvedge Denim Jeans
products.description: Heavyweight 14oz shuttle-loomed Japanese selvedge denim jeans featuring custom antique copper rivets, button fly construction, and a classic straight-leg profile that fades uniquely with wear.
products.short_description: Authentic 14oz Japanese raw selvedge denim jeans.

products.name: Heavyweight Brushed Fleece Hoodie
products.description: Constructed from cozy 450 GSM brushed cotton fleece, this everyday pullover hoodie delivers superior warmth with double-layer hood, rib-knit side panels, and durable flatlock stitching throughout.
products.short_description: Heavyweight 450 GSM brushed cotton fleece hoodie.

products.name: All-Weather Technical Shell Parka
products.description: Engineered for extreme conditions with a breathable 3-layer waterproof polyester membrane, fully taped seams, storm-flap front zipper, and an adjustable ergonomic storm hood.

products.name: Full-Grain Leather Weekender Bag
products.description: Hand-assembled from rich full-grain vegetable-tanned leather, this travel weekender includes heavy-duty brass YKK zippers, reinforced bottom base studs, and a padded adjustable shoulder strap.

products.name: PaceRunner Pro Leather Sneaker
products.description: An athletic-inspired lifestyle shoe constructed from supple Italian calfskin leather with cushioned EVA midsoles and high-abrasion rubber treads for refined performance and daily wear.

products.name: 100% Cotton Chambray Button-Down Workshirt in Navy
products.description: This classic workshirt features dual utility chest pockets and is sewn from breathable 100% cotton chambray with reinforced triple-needle stitching for lasting workshop utility.
products.short_description: Durable 100% cotton chambray utility shirt in navy.

products.name: Genuine Leather Braided Dress Belt in Brown
products.description: An artisanal braided dress belt handcrafted from genuine leather with an antique solid brass buckle designed for casual chinos as well as formal tailored trousers.
products.short_description: Handcrafted genuine leather braided belt in brown.

products.name: Extra Soft Merino Wool Ribbed Scarf in Grey
products.description: Generously proportioned winter scarf knitted from pure merino wool with ribbed hems to keep you warm and insulated throughout harsh cold-weather climates.
products.short_description: Extra soft merino wool scarf in grey.

products.name: Heavy Canvas Utility Field Jacket
products.description: A rugged military-inspired outer layer built from heavy canvas cotton fabric, designed for durable layering in transitional seasons with four exterior gear pockets.

products.name: Relaxed Fit Denim Carpenter Jeans in Blue
products.description: Classic workwear carpenter pants featuring authentic denim construction, utility tool pocket, hammer loop, and triple-needle flat-felled seam reinforcements.
products.short_description: Relaxed fit denim carpenter jeans in blue.

products.name: Garment-Dyed Heavyweight T-Shirt
products.description: Substantial 250 GSM jersey tee dyed after sewing for rich vintage color payoff, loose boxy silhouette, and durable collar ribbing.

products.name: Classic Gingham Check Casual Shirt
products.description: Crisp button-down shirt woven with timeless gingham check pattern, curved hemline for untucked wear, and contrast inner cuff lining.

products.name: Heritage Thermal Lined Zip Hoodie
products.description: Heavyweight full-zip hoodie featuring a thermal waffle knit inner lining, split kangaroo pockets, and antique brass metal zipper teeth.

products.name: Water-Resistant Windbreaker Jacket
products.description: Lightweight packable shell constructed from durable polyester ripstop with an adjustable elasticized hood and zip hand pockets.

products.name: Everyday Casual Minimalist Pullover
products.description: A versatile basic pullover designed with clean modern lines, raglan sleeves, and comfortable ribbed trims for cozy layering in any season.

products.name: Urban Commuter Weatherproof Trench
products.description: Sleek aerodynamic outer layer featuring storm-guard placket, concealed interior zippers, adjustable cuffs, and deep cargo pockets.

products.name: Heritage Leather Driving Gloves
products.description: Supple sheepskin leather driving gloves lined with warm cashmere for refined winter protection and touch-screen compatibility.

products.name: Cable-Knit Merino Wool Mittens
products.description: Thick cable-knit merino wool mittens with folded rib cuffs to insulate fingers against frigid morning temperatures.
